data.headline: Bay Area developer helps Valero assess vast Benicia refinery’s future
data.description: Valero Energy Corp. is working with Bay Area real estate firm Signature Development to assess potential redevelopment opportunities for its 900-acre Benicia oil refinery complex in Solano County, following Valero's announcement of its intent to cease or restructure refining operations there. Signature Development, known for projects like Brooklyn Basin and Tundra Energy Basin Village, will collaborate with the city of Benicia and the community to explore future plans for the site. The refinery is scheduled to close by April 2026.
